panels.title: Answer and refusal pass rate
panels.description: Weekly answer eval (chat_eval_runs, kind answer). Alerts below 85% answer, or on any refusal failure.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time, answer_pass_rate AS answer, refusal_pass_rate AS refusal
FROM chat_eval_runs
WHERE kind = 'answer' AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Red-team pass rate
panels.description: Weekly red-team eval (chat_eval_runs, kind redteam): the share of attack cases handled safely.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time, refusal_pass_rate AS "red-team"
FROM chat_eval_runs
WHERE kind = 'redteam' AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Retrieval hit@5 and MRR (live index)
panels.description: The golden questions through retrieval only, on the live index, at each answer run.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time, hit_at_5 AS "hit@5", mrr AS "MRR"
FROM chat_eval_runs
WHERE kind = 'answer' AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Eval latency p50 / p95
panels.description: Per-case compose time (retrieval, model, citation check) in each eval run, by kind.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time, kind::text AS metric, latency_p50_ms AS p50, latency_p95_ms AS p95
FROM chat_eval_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tokens per question
panels.description: Mean input + output tokens per eval case, by kind (no_match cases count as 0).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT started_at AS time, kind::text AS metric, tokens_per_question AS tokens
FROM chat_eval_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Visitor feedback per day
panels.description: helpful? [y] / [n] ratings per UTC day (chat_usage_daily, kept 90 days). Read the thumbs-down with make chat-feedback on the VM.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS time, feedback_up AS up, feedback_down AS down
FROM chat_usage_daily
WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest run's failed cases
panels.description: Failed cases of the latest run of each kind. Ids, categories and reasons come from the eval files, never from visitors.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.kind::text AS kind, f->>'id' AS "case", f->>'category' AS category, f->>'reason' AS reason, r.started_at AS run
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (kind) * FROM chat_eval_runs ORDER BY kind, started_at DESC) AS r
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(r.failures) AS f
ORDER BY 1, 2

defaults.noValue: No failed cases in the latest runs
